mentioned.quote: Another important strategy involves restricting advanced autonomy functions like self-assigning new sub-goals or executing long-horizon tasks

threshold.quote: The PRA sets a threshold for MR5 (frontier models) based on a ‘wide variety of undefined capabilities’ or high levels of autonomy.
threshold.note: The PRA table (p.2) defines the MR5 autonomy level as 'Autonomous agent without user approval' (MR4: 'with human oversight'); MR level sets governance (p.2-3).

response.quote: When a model shows capabilities of frontier AI models pre deployment we will initially restrict access to model weights to essential personnel and ensure rigorous security protocols are in place.
response.note: Triggered by frontier (MR5) capability, whose threshold includes high autonomy (p.6). Named measure: weight access limited to essential personnel.

acc_decider.note: MR5 approver p.2 is hedged and only exemplified: 'should be complete and approved by an independent committee e.g. NVIDIA’s AI ethics committee'. MR4 'business unit leader approval is required' (p.2) is a generic role label, and frontier models are MR5 (p.3).

acc_external.note: No outside review committed; the MR5 'independent committee' example is NVIDIA's own AI ethics committee (p.2). Red teaming and Garak (p.13) are not committed external review.

acc_unmet.note: Nothing says what happens if the weight restriction cannot be met; p.14 'mechanisms to pause development when necessary' is descriptive; p.12 'full market removal ... can be considered' is hedged.

mentioned.note: No misalignment, deception, oversight-undermining or shutdown-resistance risk named. p.2 'unauthorized interventions' are system errors; p.11 'human oversight' is a mitigation to slow harmful automated actions; p.13 ARC capability check is not framed as loss of control.
